特别处档案室。
档案号 L.O. 260。

事由

唐继星（又名 Tang Chi-Sing）在上海公共租界被绑架后，在天津受审并被处决。

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
5th March, 1917.

REPORT ON The Documents Relating to the Trial and Execution at
Peking of Daung Chi Sing.

Made by D.S.I.Brewster. Forwarded by

Sir,
Daung Bah (唐拔), a brother of the late Daung Chi Sing
(唐繼星) called to-day and requested the return of the
Chinese documents relating, first, to the arrest and trial of his
brother and, second, the official permit to remove his brother's
body. As these documents were handed to the Police on
condition that they would be returned on request, I beg to apply
for permission to return them to Daung Bah against his receipt.
He appears to contemplate commencing criminal proceedings
against the ex Commissioner of Foreign Affairs, Yang Tcheng,
for complicity in the kidnapping and subsequent trial and
execution of his brother.

Your obedient servant,
WB Brewster.
Detective Sub-Inspector.

Return them
MMMMMMustang

由副督察布鲁斯特（Brewster）呈报。转呈

阁下，
已故唐继星之兄唐拔（Daung Bah）今日到访，要求归还有关其弟被捕及受审的中文文件，以及移出其弟遗体的官方许可证。鉴于这些文件是在警方承诺按需归还的条件下移交的，本人谨申请获准凭唐拔出具的收据将文件归还给他。他似乎正考虑对外交特派员杨澄（Yang Tcheng）提起刑事诉讼，指控其共谋绑架其弟并导致随后的审判和处决。

您忠实的仆人，
W.B. 布鲁斯特。
副侦探督察。

予以归还
MMMMMMustang

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
10th February, 1917.
REPORT ON The Kidnapping and Execution at Peking of Daung Chi Sing (唐維星).
Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector
Sir,
I interviewed to-day Daung Bah (唐拔) alias Foh Sz (法思) a brother of Daung Chi Sing. He is one of nine brothers and he holds shares in and does some business at a spectacle shop on Tientsin Road. He lives at 83 San Tuh Li (三多里), West Gate, City. He is very well known in Shanghai. He informs me that he went to Peking about the beginning of April to investigate the execution of his brother and the result of his visit is contained in his attached statement (date 19-6-16.)
He now informs me that he left a friend at Peking in charge of further investigations. This friend has now forwarded to him a copy of the evidence and reports on the strength of which Daung was executed. These came into his hands by spending much money and much underground work. They include reports by Yang Tcheng and General Yang and a translation ~~will be forwarded in due course~~ is herewith attached.
He also informs me that the two men who are wanted for the alleged kidnapping at Shanghai, are now living in Chapei (address so far unknown), that the concubine of the deceased was continually making trouble at the house of the mother of one of the two men who are wanted, viz., Daung Ngoh Sing (唐玉軒), and that, in order to induce her to stop annoying the old woman, she received a sum of $1,000.00. The money was paid in the house of Tang Shao Yi, by him in two instalments one in October last and the other on the 11th December last.

关于唐维星（Daung Chi Sing，唐維星）在北京被绑架及处决的报告。
由警佐吉文斯（Givens）呈报。由首席侦探督察转呈
阁下，
本人今日会见了唐继星之兄唐拔（Daung Bah），又名法思（Foh Sz）。他有兄弟九人，本人在天津路一家眼镜店持有股份并从事一些业务。他居住在城内西门三多里83号。他在上海颇有名气。他告知本人，他于四月初前往北京调查其弟被处决一事，其访问结果载于所附陈述中（日期为1916年6月19日）。
他现在告知本人，他留了一位朋友在北京负责进一步调查。这位朋友现已向他转交了据以处决唐继星的证据和报告副本。这些文件是他花费大量金钱并通过许多地下工作才获得的。其中包括杨澄和杨将军的报告，译文~~将适时转交~~现随函附上。
他还告知本人，涉嫌在上海绑架的两名通缉犯目前住在闸北（地址暂不详），死者的姨太太不断在两名通缉犯之一唐玉轩（Daung Ngoh Sing）的母亲家中闹事，为了促使她停止骚扰老妇人，她收到了一笔1,000.00美元的款项。这笔钱是由唐绍仪在其家中分两期支付的，一期在去年十月，另一期在去年十二月十一日。
然而，唐拔极力强调，这笔付款绝非封口费，而仅仅是为了促使姨太太停止

1916年6月7日/5日/6日

阁下，
本人获悉，外交特派员杨澈（Yang Tcher）卷入了一起案件，该案涉及一名法租界人士唐继尧（Tang Chi Sung，唐继尧）于1914年3月6日从公共租界被绑架。
绑架是由一名亲属背叛策划并实施的。曾悬赏逮捕他，但仅支付了5,000美元。
唐继尧（Tang Chi Sung，唐继尧）立即从被抓地点被带往火车站，乘火车北上。他到了北京。他的遗体现在天津。已移交给其亲属。
杨澄（Yang Tcheng）曾发出一封电报到北京宣布抓获消息，但他是从督军那里获得该信息的，希望将此案的功劳归于自己。

您忠实的仆人，

它

Sir,
Yung Tchong, the Special Envoy for
Foreign Affairs has now assumed control
of the Government detective and secret
service agencies whose members function in
the International Settlement and in the
French Concession of Shanghai.
For this he receives extra remuneration
which has been fixed at $3000 per month.
